integrity: The central coboundary and equilibrium identities were reconstructed directly from the vector field and replayed with exact rational sparse-polynomial arithmetic by the included dependency-free checker. The support and slab-excursion arguments are analytic. Literature comparison is statement/implication based, and no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures and periodic trajectories of the positive-parameter generalized Sprott F flow. It does not establish existence, stability, mixing, entropy, or basin size. The original 1994 publisher full text was not inspected; the exact canonical equations are verified from Sprott's public Case F listing, and the two-parameter normalization is verified from his 2013 note.
title: Exact stationary circle and forced slab excursions in the Sprott F flow
